events.headline: Houthi missile strike kills at least four civilians near Yemen's Taiz
events.summary: A Houthi missile struck a crowded road near Yemen's Taiz, killing at least four civilians. The attack occurred amid fierce clashes across Taiz and Hodeidah provinces and rapid civilian displacement.

events.headline: Yemen government launches own air attacks on Houthis amid major offensive toward Bab al-Mandeb
events.summary: The Yemeni government has begun launching its own air attacks on Houthi forces as fighting intensifies. A major Houthi offensive towards the Bab al-Mandeb strait has triggered some of Yemen's worst fighting in years.

events.headline: Houthi forces push to secure Red Sea entry in southwest Yemen as fighting intensifies
events.summary: Houthi forces are trying to secure high ground and solidify control of the entry to the Red Sea in southwest Yemen. The Iran-backed militia abandoned a shaky truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July.

events.headline: Russian attacks kill at least 5 in Ukraine as US envoys visit Moscow amid limited ceasefire announcement
events.summary: At least five people were killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as US envoys visited Moscow before a planned trip to Kyiv. Ukraine and Russia announced a three-day limited ceasefire during the visit.

events.headline: Russia strikes Ukrainian security headquarters with drone in Kyiv, Zelensky says
events.summary: Russia struck a Ukrainian security headquarters with an unmanned aerial vehicle in the heart of Kyiv without warning, according to President Zelensky.

events.headline: Russian forces in Niger reportedly prioritize protecting military junta over fighting jihadists
events.summary: Russian forces brought into Niger to help combat jihadist insurgents are reported to also be focused on defending the country's military leadership. The report questions the effectiveness of Russian forces against insurgent threats versus regime protection.

events.headline: Canada-US trade war escalates as Canada weighs retaliatory options
events.summary: The trade dispute between Canada and the United States continues to escalate, with analysis examining how much Canada can retaliate given the US is its larger trading partner.

events.headline: Russian drone strikes offices of Ukraine's intelligence chief in Kyiv
events.summary: A Russian drone struck the office of Ukraine's intelligence chief in Kyiv. The attack occurred as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were reportedly planning imminent visits to Kyiv and Moscow to discuss peace efforts.

events.headline: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Moscow with new Ukraine peace plan
events.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner landed in Moscow to discuss a plan aimed at ending more than four years of war between Russia and Ukraine, in Washington's latest bid to break a diplomatic stalemate. The envoys were also expected to travel to Kyiv.

events.headline: Escalating Russian-Ukrainian airstrike campaign disrupts daily life in Kyiv
events.summary: A deadly campaign of Russian and Ukrainian airstrikes has escalated since U.S.-brokered negotiations stalled in February, with near-constant drone attacks becoming a stark new reality in Kyiv. Commuters have been stranded, children rushed underground during school hours, and festivals cancelled as a result.

events.headline: China expands currency swap agreement with Egypt, deepening trade ties
events.summary: China expanded its currency swap arrangement with Egypt as Chinese President Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi backed greater use of their currencies while linking closer financial ties. Experts say reduced reliance on the US dollar will not happen quickly.

events.headline: Unconfirmed PLA Naval Exercise Reports Near Taiwan Surface on Chinese Forums
